description: Positions of the 361 WHO standard acupoints (670 points: 309 bilateral codes x 2 sides + 52 midline codes) on the skin of the Z-Anatomy male standing body.
annotation: Each of the 361 acupoints was located by consensus of a panel of seven acupuncturists, who went through the points one by one and agreed on a single position for each; the agreed position was marked on the skin surface in a 3D annotation tool. Bilateral points are left-right symmetric: each right-side point is the mirror image (x -> -x) of its left-side counterpart.
nomenclature: Point codes, the set of 361 points and their order follow World Health Organization Regional Office for the Western Pacific, WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region (2008).

frame.origin: Z-Anatomy original origin: x = 0 is the mid-sagittal plane of the model, y = 0 is at the soles
frame.body: Z-Anatomy male body, standing, undeformed (data/body/*.glb); height of the skin 1709.5 mm

fields.side: L = body left, R = body right, M = midline (GV and CV points)
fields.index: number of the point within its meridian
fields.name_pinyin: point name in Hanyu Pinyin without tone marks
fields.name_zh: point name in simplified Chinese characters
fields.pos: [x, y, z] in mm, frame above; the point lies on the skin surface of data/body/skin.glb
fields.nearest_bone: name of the node in data/body/bone.glb whose surface is closest to pos
fields.bone_distance_mm: straight-line distance in mm from pos to the closest point on the surface of any node of data/body/bone.glb (that node is nearest_bone), rounded to 0.1 mm; a geometric distance in this model, not a needling depth
